records.claim: The SMC Points-based pathway requires 6 skilled resident points. Points can be claimed from one skill category—qualification, income or eligible occupational registration—and, where needed, additional points can come from skilled work experience in New Zealand. The applicant must also satisfy the common SMC residence requirements and have a skilled job or job offer in New Zealand.
records.methodology: Direct review of the current official SMC Resident Visa and SMC pathway guidance; evidence is scoped only to the Points-based child route.

records.claim: For the Points-based pathway, income may itself provide 3 to 6 skilled resident points depending on the multiple of the applicable SMC wage threshold; applicants using qualification or registration points must still meet the skilled employment and applicable wage settings for the residence route. The applicable wage threshold is effective-date dependent.
records.methodology: Direct review of current official SMC wage and points guidance. No separate proof-of-funds requirement is inferred from the route guidance.

records.claim: Applicants claiming qualification points must provide the qualification and, where applicable, an International Qualification Assessment; applicants claiming registration points must provide registration evidence; applicants claiming New Zealand skilled-work points must provide employment agreements and job descriptions. The residence application must substantiate the points claimed.
records.methodology: Direct review of current official SMC application evidence guidance and 2026 qualification evidential changes.
